verdict:
BAND MIS-SPECIFIED — DECLINE at $46, re-gate to ~$34±2. Both benches 8/10; blue PARTIALLY OVERTURNED red but the DECLINE survives on a better spine.

THE COHERENCE RULING (the question this court was convened on): option (b) — the $46-50 band was MIS-SPECIFIED. It was a price gate written on 2026-07-16 against a thesis whose own kill-variable is OCCUPANCY, not price, and neither bench could find the occupancy inflection the ledger made a precondition. Independently, both derived a fair band far below the touch: blue's implied-cap table puts $46.11 at a ~7.8% cap and locates margin of safety only at an 8.5-9.0% forward cap = $32-36. The band watch did its job mechanically and pointed at the wrong number. Retire 46.5; arm 34.

THE ADJUDICATOR'S OWN FINDING — the mandatory TAX leg BOTH BENCHES SKIPPED, and it is decisive on its own: the headline 7.23% is a TTM yield spanning a declared cut (red's screen-defect catch); the FORWARD yield on the $0.72 quarterly is 6.23%. REIT distributions are ORDINARY income in this taxable account, so after-tax carry is 3.32% (with the 199A 20% deduction) or 2.86% (without) — BOTH FAIL the ~3.5% after-tax bar that killed ETR/PPL/WY/NEX.PA/5802.T this same week. To clear the bar on the current dividend the price must be $43.86 (199A) or $37.77 (no 199A). So the carry case fails at the touch price even before the business case is argued, and the tax leg and the cap-rate leg converge on the high-$30s/low-$40s from opposite directions.

WHAT SURVIVED THE COURT: (1) blue's N1, the finding neither brief had — management REAFFIRMED FY26 FFO $6.35-6.45 on 8/3 against 1H26 actual $3.46, which implies a 2H of $2.89-2.99, a GUIDED 14-16% H1->H2 step-down. That simultaneously repriced the 'cheap' leg (7.7-8.0x on exit run-rate, not 7.2x) AND proved the deterioration is disclosed and modeled — DILIGENCE-only, no EDGE. (2) red's mixed-basis capital plan: the '$2.9B of dispositions' is really '$2.9B of dispositions, sales of partial interests AND OTHER CAPITAL SOURCES', and a $985.3M hybrid raised nine days after guidance can fill a third of it; uses ($3.43B) exceed sources ($2.9B), a second tell. (3) releasing spreads -7.4% SL / -9.6% cash, 86.9% occupancy, liquid-but-un-deleveraged.

WHAT DID NOT SURVIVE (red over-tagged three FATALs): the cost-of-capital crossover is arithmetically self-refuting (red's own 8.5% asset yield EXCEEDS the 7.25% hybrid, and 7.25% is the most-subordinated slice, not blended ~4.25%); 'debt-for-debt is leverage-negative' contradicts red's own finding 4; the dilution sub-finding is refuted by the dei series (share count +0.74% YoY and LOWER than Oct-2024, so tripwire #2 is NOT tripped); and capitalized-interest-roll-off was gross-for-net — the drag is the ~225bp dev-yield-vs-debt-cost spread, not the gross $295M, and red committed at 4x scale the identical basis error it had just prosecuted. Blue also flipped the capital-allocation read: choosing 7.25% paper over common equity at ~0.65x NAV is ACCRETIVE to holders, not a distress tell.

NOT A DISLOCATION: pct_off_low +17.3% — ARE has already rallied 17% off $39.42, after the print and through the hybrid. discovery_state CROWDED (S&P 500, full coverage, guidance reaffirmed).
blue_ruling: PARTIALLY OVERTURNED — 3 of red's FATALs reduced/overturned, DECLINE sustained on a new spine (N1 guide cliff + implied-cap table)

court.record: ARE_COURT_RED_202608171620 / ARE_COURT_BLUE_202608171625 (both benches Opus — Fable credits exhausted)

reopen_gates: PRICE: ~$34 (+/-2) = an 8.5-9.0% forward cap, where a 63%-debt stack finally carries margin of safety. NOT $46. The old alert_below 46.5 is RETIRED as mis-specified.

TAX FLOOR (adjudicator, independent of the business case): on the current $2.88 dividend the after-tax carry clears 3.5% only at <=$43.86 (with 199A) or <=$37.77 (without). Any carry-framed entry must state which 199A regime it assumes.
RE-COURT TRIPLE (blue's re-specification of tripwire #3 — ALL THREE, not any): cumulative closed CASH dispositions >=$2.0B AND 2H26 FFO landing >=$3.10 AND cash releasing spreads >= -3%.
DIVIDEND: another cut re-bases the entire carry leg — recompute both the after-tax floor and the cap table before any action.

DENOMINATOR WATCH (blue's correction to red): the 5.6-6.2x leverage target fails on EBITDA, not on disposition dollars — at forward ~$1.71B EBITDA, $11.32B net debt = 6.6x. Watch EBITDA, not the disposition headline.
process_findings: MANDATORY LEG SKIPPED BY BOTH BENCHES: the court context made tax-adjusted carry leg #1 and neither bench computed it. Adjudicator computed it and it was decisive. Bench templates need a compliance check that every MANDATORY leg in the dispatch context is answered or explicitly declared UNCHECKABLE.

ATLAS SLATE DRIFT (blue's catch): red's DETECTORS CONSULTED addressed six detectors NOT in this case's dispatch list while omitting six that WERE dispatched, on an identical pack. An atlas section answering a different slate is not a validated sweep — output-side validator should diff consulted-vs-dispatched mechanically.

COVERAGE GAP, escalated by BOTH benches as the highest-value connector build this case argues for: county recorder deed/transfer records for San Diego, San Mateo, King and Montgomery counties would timestamp disposition closings weeks ahead of the 3Q26 print and directly resolve the binding question. Library currently has recorder coverage only for Allegheny County PA.
SCREEN DEFECT: the TTM dividend yield (7.23%) spans a declared cut; the forward yield is 6.23%. Any yield-screened REIT row must use forward, not TTM.
